2820.ed: People say this restaurant offers delicious and rich malatang soup with a wide variety of ingredients to choose from, allowing for customization. They also highlight the reasonable prices, quick service, and friendly staff. Some reviews mention the space can be extremely cramped.
2820.edj: クチコミによると、このレストランは、美味しくて濃厚な麻辣湯スープを提供しており、豊富な種類の具材から選んでカスタマイズできる点が評価されています。また、手頃な価格、迅速なサービス、感じの良いスタッフも特徴のようです。 一方で、店内が非常に狭いという意見もあります。

rv.t: Food is good, but will not come back. Payment type: Cash, PayPay, and QR code payments As much as the food was amazing, the experience itself ruined it for me. Upon arriving at the store, the lady gave us a time ticket, so we didn’t have to wait out in the cold, which was very nice. When we came back, we had to wait an extra 10min outside the store, but it was still fine. Things got stressful the moment we got…

got too excited when my food came and forgot to take a photo before eating lol. great value malatang, not too spicy, no notes 👍 if u come alone, though, beware that they will seat u with strangers haha

Love malatang here You can choose whatever you want to eat And if you select stuff above to 1,000 jpy There will service you a noodle as free! And you can select the level of spicy! Very goooood one!!

2821.ed: Modern, ultraluxe boutique offering high-end timepieces from the venerable Swiss watch maker.
2821.edj: スイスの由緒ある時計メーカーの高級腕時計が揃う、モダンで気品のあるブティック。

rv.t: One of the best experiences you can have as a watch enthusiast. The gift at the end makes you appreciate more on what goes into a watch. Area is also very accessible which makes it easy to get to. Booking recommended

We had such an amazing time at AP Lab on our last day in Tokyo! The staff were incredibly welcoming and helpful. Since my wife and I were the only non-locals there, a dedicated staff member stayed with us the entire time to translate everything. Thank you so much to the whole team, and a special thanks for the gift after completing Level 2! I highly recommend this experience to anyone who wants to learn more about…

Such a amazing experience at ap labs as I did register about a month ahead of the visit it’s recommended to register early as they do not allow walk ins the level 1-2 activities were very fun and very engaging and the level 2 is where you do learn about the finishing of the frosted texture satin finish and the pearlage and you can keep the necklace as well which was really nice and there’s a sticker as well overall…

2822.a: TOKYO NODE, 東京都港区虎ノ門二丁目６番２ 虎ノ門ヒルズ ステーションタワー8F、45F〜49F, 6, Minato City, Tokyo 105-0001, Japan
2822.aj: 〒105-0001 東京都港区６ TOKYO NODE 東京都港区虎ノ門二丁目６番２ 虎ノ門ヒルズ ステーションタワー8F、45F〜49F
2822.ed: People say this exhibition space features immersive and engaging exhibits, with many highlighting the "Ghost in the Shell" and "Design Ah" exhibitions as particularly enjoyable. Visitors also appreciate the clean and well-maintained facilities, including spotless restrooms and convenient coin lockers. They also like the stunning city views from the high-rise venue.
2822.edj: クチコミによると、この展示スペースは没入感があり魅力的な展示が特徴で、「攻殻機動隊」展や「デザインあ」展が特に好評です。また、清潔で手入れの行き届いた施設も高く評価されており、特にきれいなトイレや便利なコインロッカーが挙げられています。高層階にあるため、素晴らしい都市の眺望も人気のようです。

rv.t: Recently visited for the first time to attend the Tokyo Rooms exhibit. There’s plenty of signage so it was relatively easy to locate, especially coming from the Hibiya Line. You just have to take a few elevators to get up there. I visited midday on a weekday so it was relatively calm in the venue and I didn’t need to worry about crowds. I enjoy the location and hope to visit again for another exhibit sometime…

I came here to experience the “Ghost in the Shell” exhibit, and it was pretty interesting. To find it, enter the building and take the elevator to the 8th floor. Then buy a ticket at the machine or counter, use the lockers, and take the elevator up to the 48th. The first room you enter has really tall ceilings with videos playing on all the walls and interactive stations where you can do a deep dive into movie…

A futuristic high rise building, suitable for many kinds of events and also strategically located above a subway station. Went here and immediately stored my luggage on a coin locker for a limited time event. Overall, it's a very convenient place to visit at any time.

いい雰囲気! reasonable price ! Almost good except Little bit fish smell on dish.
The place is nice. Price is reasonable. Would love to visit again!

2824.ed: Contemporary hotel featuring minimalist rooms that have balconies & views of Mount Fuji.
2824.edj: 富士山を一望できるバルコニー付きのシンプルな客室を備えたモダンなホテル。

rv.t: What a wonderful place to stay, we absolutely loved this hotel. The view of Mount Fuji from the private balcony is incredible and unforgettable. The location is perfect, making it easy to explore the area. The service was outstanding from start to finish. We booked the entire third floor for our family, and it was absolutely worth it. Having a private elevator that opens directly into your floor, along with all the…

the suite was excellent. no words to describe it, the entire third floor of the building was the suite we booked and the view of fuji from the room was immaculate. service was exemplary from the time we stepped in. definitely would book again, thank you so much!
Imagine clear and full Mount Fuji view from your room. It’s stunning. This is what you will get. Cleanliness needs some improvement. Hair found in clean towels. Overall, it is worth recommending.

2825.a: El Alona, 大塚ビル 1F 4 Chome-1-7 Nakameguro, Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0061, Japan
2825.aj: 〒153-0061 東京都目黒区中目黒４丁目１−７ 大塚ビル 1F 中目黒 スペイン料理 エル・アローニャ

rv.t: 10/10! This could well be one of the best Spanish cuisines I’ve had - including the ones from Barcelona. Best mussels ever. Heavenly fresh, creamy and melting- didn’t know mussels could be like that! Olives are huge plus, couldn’t stop getting more of them and some wines to go with !

The small store is perfect for visiting with like-minded friends. The course appetizer pate and chili pepper pinchos will grab your attention. The chain of deliciousness continues with salad and pork loin, culminating in paella. I want U to try a famous Spanish restaurant in Tokyo. .
Authentic Spanish food, and the owner is very friendly! We usually come here for special occasions. Especially the paella and the liver pathé are very delicious!

2826.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and rich pudding, as well as its wide variety of food and dessert options. They also highlight the calm and stylish atmosphere, with many mentioning the pleasant riverside views. Other reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
2826.edj: 春には桜を眺めることができる目黒川沿いのロケーション。ランチとディナーでそれぞれメニューを提供。スイーツも種類を用意している。

rv.t: Change the chef please. The daily soup - tomatoe soup with Tabasco and sausages damn it. Sour and Spicy of the soup will not be tasty okay? Curry rice is cold not even warm.
Cute restaurant with amazing environment 🫶big portions and nice salad, pasta is average tho

Really nice atmosphere and the food is good as well. If you want a nice place to chat and have some good food I would definitely recommend. Both the drinks and food are good. I recommend their sampler plate as well as anything on the seasonal menu.

2827.aj: 〒153-0051 東京都目黒区上目黒１丁目５−１０ 108 Kento's Burger
2827.ed: Diners like this burger joint's delicious and authentic burgers, especially the Apple Jam Bacon Cheeseburger, which features tender patties, crispy bacon, and fresh ingredients. They also highlight the homemade ginger ale and crispy fries. Guests mention the friendly and welcoming staff, the pet-friendly atmosphere, and the reasonable prices for the quality.
2827.edj: このハンバーガー店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、本格的で美味しいハンバーガーが高く評価されています。特に、柔らかいパティ、カリカリのベーコン、新鮮な食材が特徴のアップルジャムベーコンチーズバーガーがおすすめです。自家製ジンジャーエールとカリカリのフライドポテトも評判のようです。親しみやすいスタッフ、ペット同伴可能な雰囲気、品質に見合った手頃な価格も、訪れた人から良い評価を得ています。

rv.t: One of the best burgers I’ve ever tasted. The burger patty is tender, flavourful and juicy. I had the Apple Jam Bacon Cheeseburger, and it was delicious! The Apple chunks wasn’t too sweet, thus being the perfect blend of flavours with the savoury beef patty. I would definitely come back for more.
The staff were very friendly and welcoming. I tried the double smash burger which was really tasty with very fresh ingredients. The atmosphere and the decoration were really good too.

This is a great burger, non-traditional and intriguing in a number of ways. Kento's burger is right along the Meguro river promenade in a location that changes to an entirely different restaurant at night. But if you want a burger for lunch, this is worth a try. I ordered the burger with bacon and apple jam. It sounds interesting and it is, not just because of the toppings. It has this thick cut bacon that's salty…

2828.a: Iroha Sushi Honten, 1 Chome-30-10 Aobadai, Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0051, Japan
2828.aj: 〒153-0051 東京都目黒区青葉台１丁目３０−１０ いろは寿司 本店
2828.ed: Diners like this sushi restaurant's delicious and fresh sushi, especially the "me-negi" (baby leek) and quail egg gunkan, along with a wide variety of other dishes like crispy fried chicken and tempura. They also highlight the reasonable prices, lively atmosphere, and friendly staff, noting it's open late and offers an English menu. Some reviews mention the billing can be inaccurate.
2828.edj: この寿司レストランを利用したユーザーは、新鮮で美味しい寿司を高く評価しています。特に「芽ねぎとウズラの卵の軍艦」がおすすめとして挙げられています。また、サクサクの唐揚げや天ぷらなど、寿司以外の料理も種類豊富で美味しいという声が多くあります。リーズナブルな価格、活気ある雰囲気、親しみやすいスタッフも好評です。深夜まで営業しており、英語のメニューがあることも特徴です。 一方で、クチコミの中には会計が不正確だったという意見もあります。

rv.t: I’ve been a big fan of this place for many years. It’s always busy, but you can enjoy sushi at a reasonable price. I highly recommend the Mene-gi Uzura Tamago (scallion sprouts with quail egg). There’s another one along the Meguro River. Perfect for dinner/drinks with friends. It’s open late, and it’s fun to write your own orders.
The perfect place to enjoy sushi. They have a picture menu for non-Japanese speakers.
Delicious sushi and lovely staff. Thank you for the lovely evening!

2829.a: flour＋water Nakameguro, 1 Chome-30-10 Aobadai, Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0042, Japan

catj: モダン居酒屋レストラン
伝統的な紅茶・緑茶店
2829.ed: People say this bakery offers a wide variety of delicious breads, including popular croissants and flavorful shokupan, along with tasty soups and pizzas. They also highlight the excellent value of the brunch set, which includes four bread selections and unlimited tea. Visitors consistently praise the staff for their friendly, attentive, and welcoming service, creating a pleasant and enjoyable…
2829.edj: このベーカリーカフェを利用した人は、人気のクロワッサンや風味豊かな食パンをはじめ、様々な種類の美味しいパンが豊富に揃っていると評価しています。また、美味しいスープやピザも高く評価されています。4種類のパンと紅茶のフリードリンクが含まれるブランチセットは、コストパフォーマンスが優れているという声が多くあります。訪れた人は皆、スタッフの親しみやすく、きめ細やかな、温かいサービスを常に称賛しており、心地よく楽しい雰囲気を作り出しているようです。

rv.t: It all started with a walk-in 😂 My friend took me to this place, but it was very crowded that day. The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming! He explained the wait time and said he would do his best to accommodate us if we wanted to wait for a table, but it would have been at least a 2-hour wait 😂. There was a small outdoor seating area just outside the shop, so we decided to order takeout and eat there…

Great selection of breads and pastry. Go with the set meal with the choice of 4 types of bakes of your choice, 1 side of choice. Enjoyed the overall experience and ambience as well! The bake goods were amazing, especially the baguettes. Leftovers can take away as well. Recommended bakery!

We were misled to believe that this cafe served more than just bread. At the timing we went, we walked in at around 12pm and were offered a table for 2 at 1.30pm. We were served the brunch set which consisted of either a soup/salad/dessert along with 4 pieces of bread of your choice for 1800 yen. It was quite a long wait and they were starting to turn away walk-in customers after us. Perhaps due to the language…

2830.a: Inaka no taihou, Yamanokami-65-1 Yatsuaicho, Ayabe, Kyoto 623-1122, Japan
2830.aj: 〒623-1122 京都府綾部市八津合町山ノ神65−１ 田舎の大鵬
2830.ed: Diners like this restaurant's creative Chinese cuisine, which features fresh ingredients from its own farm and livestock, and say the dishes offer unique flavors. They also highlight the stunning natural scenery and open-air dining experience. Others mention the clean and modern restrooms.
2830.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、自家農園や畜産で採れた新鮮な食材を使った創作中華料理を高く評価しており、その料理は独特の風味があるという声が多くあります。また、素晴らしい自然の景色と開放的な屋外での食事体験も特徴として挙げられています。清潔で近代的なトイレについても言及されています。

rv.t: This is a unique culinary experience in the countryside of Ayabe, that offers a transformative perspective on slow living and sustainable cooking. They grow a lot of the ingredients they use and do their best to be self-sufficient. You can really feel their passion to take care of the land and the animals that live in it, incorporating them into the menu in a sustainable way. Because of this the menu changes with…

京都駅からハイヤーで約90分、山奥にある完全予約制の一軒。 ここは単なる食事ではなく、体験としての価値が圧倒的に高い店。 インスタで予約必須 人数多い場合は貸切になります 夏の時期は夕方。春の時期は12時からのスタート 2年かけて育てた鶏をその場で調理し、 新鮮な状態で鍋としていただくスタイル。 歯応えはしっかり、噛むほどに旨みが広がる“本来の鶏の味”が感じられる。 過程にはやや刺激的なシーンも含まれるため、 そこも含めて受け止められる人向け。 山菜も採れたてで、味が濃く香りも良い。 半野外の空間でいただく食事は開放感があり、京都市内よりも少し涼しく心地いい。 食・自然・命を一体で感じる、他にはない体験型レストラン。

【田舎の大鵬｜京都の山奥で五感をほどく絶景中華体験】 「ここ、本当に京都!?」ってなるぐらい、自然に囲まれた山奥にひっそり佇む隠れ家中華レストラン**「田舎の大鵬」**へ。 テラス席からは、山々と青空を一望できる最高のロケーション。まさに、自然と食が一体になる感覚。 料理はすべて、隣接する自家農園や畜産から採れたての食材を使用。 朝に捌かれたばかりの新鮮な鶏肉を、絶妙な火入れで仕上げた炒め物や旨味が染み出す土鍋ご飯、そしてふわっふわの蒸しパン…。 一品一品が丁寧で、どこか懐かしさも感じる味わい。 中国茶の香りとともにいただく時間は、まるで異世界に迷い込んだような感覚。 コースは15000円。都会じゃ味わえない“本物の中華”と、“自然”のフルコース。 これは一度行ったら、絶対また来たくなる。

2831.a: YGF Malatang - Okubo, 牧田ビル 1F 2 Chome-21-2 Hyakunincho, Shinjuku City, Tokyo 169-0073, Japan
2831.aj: 〒169-0073 東京都新宿区百人町２丁目２１−２ 牧田ビル 1F 楊国福マーラータン大久保店
2831.ed: People say this restaurant offers a wide variety of fresh ingredients for customizable malatang, including diverse vegetables, meats, and noodles, with options for various soup bases and spice levels. They also highlight the clean interior, efficient service, and the value of free noodles when orders exceed 1000 yen. Guests mention the authentic, flavorful, and addictive taste, making it a…
2831.edj: このレストランを訪れた人は、麻辣湯の具材として新鮮な野菜、肉、麺など、幅広い種類の食材が用意されており、好みに合わせて選べると評価しています。スープの種類や辛さのレベルも選べるため、自分だけの麻辣湯を楽しめるという声が多くあります。店内は清潔感があり、サービスも効率的で、1,000円以上の注文で麺が無料になる点も好評です。本格的で風味豊かな、やみつきになる味わいが人気で、満足度の高い食事ができるとされています。

rv.t: The food is delicious. I highly recommend the malatang soup. It's priced at ¥400 per 100 grams. If your order exceeds ¥1000, you can get free noodles of various kinds. The only downside for me was the staff. They didn't explain the different soup options, and since it was my first time, I didn't know what to try. Their greetings also felt a bit scripted. But overall, it was good and I enjoyed it.

I'd wanted to go here for a while, but it looked confusing and everything seemed to be in Chinese. However, (now) all the instructions are also in Japanese and English, and it was pretty easy. Basically, the ingredients are in a fridge along the left-hand side. 1. take a bowl and tongs from the cabinet 2. take anything you fancy from the fridge and put it in the bowl 3. go to the till where the bowl is weighed 4…

Really really delicious spicy hot pot place recently opened just in front of Okubo station. The address on Google takes you down a suburban street but the shop is actually on the main road right next to Pepper Lunch. Look for an orange sign. Really large seating area that can cater over 30 people. Instead of individual prices, the hot pot is by weight so ¥400 per 100g. I think this is quite a fair price for spicy…

2832.aj: 〒990-2301 山形県山形市蔵王温泉２２９−３ 樹氷幻想回廊ツアー（雪上車ツアー）

2833.a: cafe Felice, ガーデンスクウェア １Ｆ 1 Chome-27-20 Nakamuraminami, Nerima City, Tokyo 176-0025, Japan
2833.aj: 〒176-0025 東京都練馬区中村南１丁目２７−２０ ガーデンスクウェア １Ｆ カフェ フェリーチェ
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2833.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious pasta gratin, pizza, and freshly baked bread, with many highlighting the generous portions. They also appreciate the relaxing, green atmosphere, often comparing it to a mountain resort, and the availability of dog-friendly terrace seating. Guests mention the attentive staff and convenient parking, making it an ideal spot for a leisurely meal.
2833.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、パスタグラタンやピザ、焼きたてのパンを評価しており、ボリュームがあるというクチコミが多くあります。山のリゾートのような、緑豊かで落ち着いた雰囲気を気に入ったという声や、犬同伴可能なテラス席があることも好評です。また、スタッフの気配りや便利な駐車場も、ゆったりと食事を楽しむのに理想的だと評価されています。

rv.t: Polite staff, cosy atmosphere, and tasty food and drink! A really lovely spot to enjoy nature with a drink, but make sure to bring bug spray 😭 The bike parking is also very annoying. I had to lift my bike over my head to get it out.

Staff were polite and nice. The cafe interior was relaxing. It was adorable seeing other customers bringing in their cute dogs. The food was a bit disappointing; flavors were on point but the pizza was undercooked and tart crust was soggy

A truly relaxing cafe experience. Makes you feel far away from the hustle and bustle of Tokyo. The portions are generous and the taste is fresh and scrumptious. The cinnamon roll with ice cream dessert was the perfect fit for this glorious autumn afternoon.

2834.aj: 〒626-0001 京都府宮津市文珠４８４−１ 海鮮料理 美加茂
2834.ed: Easygoing restaurant spotlighting seafood dishes, from sashimi to steamed clams.
2834.edj: 刺身やあさりの酒蒸しなど、さまざまな海鮮料理を中心とした気軽なレストラン。

rv.t: If you want to have lunch here, it’s better to make reservations before you come. We ordered a bbq set for 2 people and 1 Turban shell rice. Everything is fresh and delicious. Staff would teach us how to grill those seafood. You will get 💯 food by following their instructions. Highly recommended ❣️

Awesome small restaurant run by an old couple. For dinner they only accept guests with reservation, but they were kind enough to make an exception for us. The next day was sunny, and it had a long line for lunch, so maybe reservation for lunch is also recommended. The food was really fresh and very tasty. I can really recommend the sake tasting set, where you get 3 small cups of different sake. If you're unsure…

Excellent Sashimi and fantastic sake-steamed clams, the broth was so flavourful, absolutely delicious. The owner was extremely kind and friendly. You better book ahead because this area is super busy.

2834.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 12:00

2835.a: DILL COFFEE PARLOR, ワダビル 2 Chome-4-6 Kanda Nishikicho, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 101-0054, Japan
2835.aj: 〒101-0054 東京都千代田区神田錦町２丁目４−６ ワダビル DILL COFFEE PARLOR
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2835.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, including lattes and Americanos, alongside excellent homemade cakes like the rich cheesecake and spicy carrot cake. They also highlight the spacious, stylish, and comfortable interior, with many seating options across two floors, making it ideal for relaxing or working. Guests mention the staff are kind and helpful, and appreciate the clean…
2835.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、ラテやアメリカーノをはじめとするコーヒーが美味しいという声が多く聞かれます。濃厚なチーズケーキやスパイシーなキャロットケーキなど、自家製ケーキも高く評価されています。店内は広々としていておしゃれで、2フロアにわたって様々なタイプの座席があるため、リラックスしたり作業をしたりするのに理想的という意見があります。スタッフは親切で丁寧な対応をしてくれるというクチコミもあり、清潔で手入れの行き届いた環境も好評です。

rv.t: Went here on a weekend. We went back thrice since there was quite a queue. Luckily, there was no queue anymore the 3rd time we went. The place was spacious inside. Sadly, the staffs were unfriendly that it was quite uncomfortable. We ordered an Iced Latte & Carrot Cake. The Carrot Cake was good. The Latte was okay.

Absolutely amazing. This is one of the best muffins I have eaten in Tokyo and the coffee was very good. From outside, it looks small but inside it is very spacious and has a very relaxed atmosphere. You can see the kitchen where they prepare the pastries. I definitely recommend.

First time dining in here, and Friday evening wasn't really crowded. After I entered the cafe, the staff asked me to reserve a seat before ordering and I reserved a seat at the second floor. I ordered 1 Double Ice Mocha🍫☕️ with a Carrot Cake🥕🍰. And honestly one of the best carrot cake I ever had! It was moist and tasted good! (Long before one of my friend bought their cookie and it tasted good too!) This cafe has 2…

2836.a: Japan, 〒402-0228 Yamanashi, Minamitsuru District, Doshi, 村長又12498-10 道志村RentalVilla12498番地
2836.aj: 〒402-0228 山梨県南都留郡道志村村長又１２４９８−１０ 道志村RentalVilla12498番地

rv.t: 自然に囲まれたロケーションと、オシャレでどこか不思議な空間がとても魅力的で、日常を離れて心からリラックスできました。 BBQやサウナ、焚き火、暖炉など楽しみ方がたくさんあり、特に火を眺めながらゆっくり過ごす時間は格別。時間の流れがいつもよりゆっくり感じられるような贅沢なひとときでした。 また、キッチンの調理器具や調味料が充実していたのも嬉しいポイント。細かな気配りが感じられ、快適に滞在できました。 自然の中でゆったりと過ごしたい方におすすめです。また違う季節にも訪れたいと思います。
12月に友人との旅行にて利用しました。 寒い時期でしたが室内は薪ストーブで暖かく、大変過ごしやすかったです。リビングのインテリアがとにかく素敵で、特別な時間になりました。 備え付けのサウナをこの旅のメインイベントにしていましたが、水風呂も広く、外気浴も開放的で最高でした。また別の季節にも是非訪れたいです！
駐車場が積雪で使えず、自分たちで雪かきを行うよう求められました。 事前案内にスタッドレスまたはチェーンとの記載で、後から「連絡した」と言われた点にも不信感があります。 運営会社に電話しましたが対応はありませんでした。 管理・説明・トラブル対応、いずれにも問題を感じます。

2837.a: Ice Village, Nakatomamu, Shimukappu, Yufutsu District, Hokkaido 079-2204, Japan
2837.aj: 〒079-2204 北海道勇払郡占冠村中トマム星野リゾート トマム アイスヴィレッジ
2837.ed: Winter village featuring a frozen church, cafe, bar & candy store, plus a skating rink & ice slide.
2837.edj: 氷の教会、カフェ、バー、スイーツ ショップのほか、スケートリンクや氷の滑り台がある冬の街。

rv.t: We visited the Ice Village and had an amazing time. The entire village felt like a real-life winter fairytale, with beautifully crafted ice buildings, glowing lights, and unique attractions made entirely of ice. We took lots of photos—the atmosphere is incredibly photogenic, especially at night when everything is illuminated. Walking through the ice chapel, ice bar, and frozen pathways was a truly memorable…

some facilities were not opened during my visit only 3 igloos serves food (have to pay separately course): - 1 sells drinks in ice cube - 1 sells cheese fondue/ramen(¥1500)/marshmallows(¥500 for only ONE big marshmallow on a stick.. apparently many are still buying) - 1 sells sweet treats only chinese payment methods or cash, no credit card accepted, which i think is a little ridiculous for such a high class hotel…

It’s a unique place that’s worth visiting, but it was smaller than I expected. You can cover the entire village in just a few steps, so you don’t really need more than an hour if you’re just there to sightsee. If you’d like to do things like ice skating and dine, maybe add another hour tops. When someone gets married at the ice chapel, fireworks will go off. The chapel itself is open to the public at 3 specific…

2838.a: Inaseya Seijo, コーラルビル 2 Chome-35-8 Seijo, Setagaya City, Tokyo 157-0066, Japan
2838.aj: 〒157-0066 東京都世田谷区成城２丁目３５−８ コーラルビル いなせや 成城店

rv.t: This Izakaya is tucked away in a basement on the side road of Seijo train station, but glad we found it. Nicely designed, chic and cozy atmosphere for a Izakaya. All the grilled dishes are made in front of the counter table, you can see the chef grilling the dishes to perfection and all the dishes we tried was seasoned perfectly, grilled to perfection and tasted delicious. Even a simple onion such as was grilled…

We have been here 3 times now, so it’s fast becoming the Seijo ‘Go To’. They always manage to find us a spot at lunch without reservation and thanks to a well-rounded menu and daily specials, we order something different and ultimately delicious every time. Nothing in English, but can recommend the seared fish on rice, the karaage and sashimi plate. Still plenty of menu items to try, so will be back soon.
It's in the basement (watch the stairs down from the street - they're steep!) and worth a visit. This place specialises in fish - but I get the chicken namban (at ¥1200).

2838.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2839.a: DANCING CRAB TOKYO, 新宿ＮＯＷＡ 2F 3 Chome-37-12 Shinjuku, Shinjuku City, Tokyo 160-0022, Japan
2839.aj: 〒160-0022 東京都新宿区新宿３丁目３７−１２ 新宿ＮＯＷＡ 2F ダンシングクラブ東京
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
2839.ed: People say this restaurant offers delicious seafood, including crab, shrimp, and lobster, served with flavorful sauces, and highlights the unique, fun, and interactive hand-eating style. They also mention the lively atmosphere with staff dance shows and magic performances, making it ideal for celebrations. Other reviews mention the food can be overpriced.
2839.edj: アメリカ南部のケイジャン料理をアジア風にアレンジしたシーフード各種を、ナイフやフォークを使わず手づかみで堪能できる。

rv.t: The staff are nice and the ambience is great... but the food was either over cooked or under cooked. I order seafood boil and it was not seasoned very well. The signature sauce is ok but I can tell it has sugar in it. The potato in the boil was under cooked and hard. I also ordered a blooming onion and it too was under cooked. The onion was still raw and the batter wet and soggy in the middle.
Food was ok. The Seafood boil, needs to be over hauled. True Louisiana flavor was not there. Especially that it was a tomato base boil.

Delicious seafood and super fun dining experience! Tokyo Dancing Crab is such a unique and entertaining restaurant! The seafood is fresh, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned — especially the crab and shrimp. The way they serve the food directly on the table makes it exciting and interactive. The music, dancing, and energetic staff create a lively atmosphere that makes dining here unforgettable. Perfect for groups…

2839.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2840.a: Kamakura no Sato, Kotobuki, Iiyama, Nagano 389-2418, Japan
2840.aj: 〒389-2418 長野県飯山市寿かまくらの里
2840.ed: Visitors say this snow dome village offers a unique experience of dining inside igloo-like domes, with many highlighting the delicious and hearty nabe hotpot. They also appreciate the magical atmosphere, especially at night when the domes are lit up, and the helpful staff. Guests mention the convenient free parking and the availability of other snow activities for children.
2840.edj: このスノードーム村を訪れた人は、かまくらのようなドーム内で食事ができるユニークな体験を評価しており、特に美味しくてボリュームのある鍋料理を挙げる人が多くいます。ドームがライトアップされる夜の幻想的な雰囲気や、親切なスタッフの対応も高く評価されています。無料駐車場が利用できる点や、子ども向けの雪遊びができる点も好評のようです。

rv.t: We visited Kamakura Snow Dome Village and it was honestly one of the most magical winter experiences in Japan. During the day, the whole place looks like a snowy fairytale village with rows of igloo-like domes set against a beautiful mountain backdrop. At night, the atmosphere completely changes. the snow domes light up softly and the entire place feels peaceful, dreamy, and almost unreal. We had the chance to sit…

Limited time attraction annual. 2026 Jan 23 until March 1. This Kamakura (ice house or igloo) is conveniently located with parking about 17 minutes drive from Ilyama town. Pot hot pot is served (reservation recommended) inside an igloo. Extra dished can be added on. Drink and other can be purchased at the store located at the venue. About 22 igloo in total. Driving is recommended as busses are seldom after 6pm. Oh…

Need to reserve before going there. There’s only (I think) 12 igloos so best to reserve beforehand. We were seated at 5:30pm but the experience only start at 6:30pm, so we kind of had to wait for awhile in the igloo, which can be pretty cold. The food is delicious and surprisingly huge portion! For a $90/person experience, I think the weather, environment & food makes up for it! Worth a visit !

2841.a: Kadokawa Musashino Museum, ところざわサクラタウン 3 Chome-31-3 Higashitokorozawawada, Tokorozawa, Saitama 359-0023, Japan

2841.ed: Striking cultural complex known for the huge Bookshelf Theater library, plus displays on anime.
2841.edj: アニメも表示される巨大な本棚劇場ライブラリで知られる、人目を引く文化複合施設。

rv.t: If you are a manga fan then this is your mecca . I am not one but my son spent hours at the special exhibition and the manga library. The book theatre ‘s light show is spectacular and runs on the hour, 20 and 40 min. The library houses mainly Japanese books but it’s worth a stroll just to enjoy the way they exhibit their books , and there are other exhibits ( old PCs , chips planted in humans after UFO kidnappings…

Kadokawa Culture Museum is a very unique and impressive museum experience. The architecture alone is stunning, and the atmosphere inside feels modern, artistic, and different from a typical museum. The library space is especially beautiful and worth seeing in person. There are interesting exhibits, great photo spots, and a relaxing environment to walk around and explore. Even if you’re not deeply into museums, it’s…

If you like books and unique architecture, you can’t miss this one. They have schedules for the bookshelves project mapping that is very cool. They also have a unique cafe that you can have some nice food

2842.aj: 〒195-0073 東京都町田市薬師台１丁目７３３−１ 町田リス園
2842.ed: Hundreds of squirrels live in this whimsical, colorful garden that also has guinea pigs & rabbits.
2842.edj: 何百匹ものリスがいるカラフルで個性的な小規模動物園。モルモットやウサギも飼育している。

rv.t: A small place where u can feed and squirrels, guinea pigs, rabbits, and tortoise. NO petting them, so if u wanna pet cute animals, this is not the place. There's a big park beside it to chill, once you're done. Overall it's so-so. Kinda hot if u go in Summer.

The squirrels are accustomed to people, so even small children can enjoy feeding them sunflower seeds. It is a truly wonderful, fairytale-like place. I hope this peace lasts forever. A huge tortoise was strolling through the squirrel park—it was quite an impressive sight.

I am sorry to say, but this made me tear up and very sad. I know that going somewhere to look at animals in enclosures is a shaky proposition at best. But this looked like a squirrel internment camp. There is nearly no shade, no natural water sources or little water holes, no leaves and nothing to hide behind. Also some of the squirrels seemed sick. They are very keen on getting the sunflower seeds and the staff is…

この公園内で唯一の滝。水量はそれほどでもないけど、やけに人懐っこい鯉が可愛いし、もみじの配置も素晴らしいですね。 前回紅葉の時期に来た時にこのスポットは来てなかったので、ちょっと悔やまれますね

2844.ed: Visitors say this park offers beautiful natural scenery, including seasonal flowers and walking paths, along with a cafe serving delicious food and soft-serve ice cream. 2844.edj: この公園を訪れた人は、四季折々の花や散策路など、美しい自然の景色を楽しめることに加えて、おいしい食事やソフトクリームを提供するカフェがあることを評価しています。また、直売所では新鮮で質の高い地元の農産物が手に入ることや、清潔で手入れの行き届いたトイレも良いというクチコミが多くあります。 一方で、公園が小さいという意見もあります。

rv.t: Very nice place for passing Family time. So comfortable because the place is very clean.
Nice park
Nice place for passing time with family.

2845.ed: Visitors say this park offers beautiful seasonal flowers like irises, hydrangeas, and lotus, along with stunning autumn foliage and unique light-up events. They also highlight the free admission, reasonable parking fees, and well-maintained paths suitable for strollers and wheelchairs. Guests mention the peaceful atmosphere and the presence of historic homes, a tea house, and food trucks.
2845.edj: この公園を訪れた人は、アヤメ、アジサイ、ハスなどの美しい季節の花々や、見事な紅葉、ユニークなライトアップイベントを高く評価しています。また、入園料が無料であること、駐車料金が手頃であること、ベビーカーや車椅子でも利用しやすいように道が整備されていることも特徴として挙げられています。静かな雰囲気や、歴史的な古民家、茶屋、キッチンカーがあることについてもクチコミがあります。

rv.t: Simply exquisite when the wisteria is in bloom. Not even the violent, unwelcoming ranting of a grumpy photographer could put me off this place. The garden is beautiful, lush and exceptionally well-maintained. Worth a visit.

Beautiful place that provides a view of a variety of flowers throughout the year. You can see sakura, plum, wisteria, water lilies, momiji, ginkgo and many others providing an amazing natural experience of each japanese season. They also have some nice food options on the premise. You can also experience traditional Japanese snacks at the Chaya (Japanese tea shop). Has a thatched roof clinic inside the park which…
Love this place. I came here to see iris and absolutely gorgeous! It’s a must visit spot!

rv.t: Beautiful house.
What a beautiful village and still very unkown with almost no tourists.
舟屋でも梁は太くビックリしました！ 今の住宅の４倍はあるとおもいます。 柄は固定されておらず波等に柔軟に造られているのも先人の知恵なのでしょう！

2847.a: Miyabi Ine Boathouse Cafe, 552 Hirata, Ine, Yoza District, Kyoto 626-0423, Japan
2847.aj: 〒626-0423 京都府与謝郡伊根町平田５５２ 雅 みやび
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2847.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious dango and a variety of desserts and drinks. They also highlight the breathtaking views of Ine Bay from the open-air terrace and garden seating. Guests mention the staff are friendly and the atmosphere is calm.
2847.edj: このカフェを利用した人によると、美味しい団子や様々な種類のデザート、ドリンクが提供されているようです。また、オープンエアのテラス席や庭の席からは、伊根湾の息をのむような景色が楽しめるという声が多くあります。スタッフは親しみやすく、落ち着いた雰囲気だというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Great view Dessert was nice Apple juice is so good Staff is friendly Various menu of dessert and drinks 🍡🧃🍨

A great alternative to the always popular Ine Cafe nearby. They only serve dango and simple drinks, but if you want proper meal you can visit nearby restaurants during lunch time and come back to enjoy some delicious dango. This is more historical than Ine cafe as it kept quite a bit of its original form. Seating is a bit limited. If you are not going for food (make sure to at least get a drink before going in)…
Delicious rice dumpling and green tea! Owner is very kind. Hidden gem with no queue. View is great! Price is affordable!

2848.a: Japan, 〒401-0305 Yamanashi, Minamitsuru District, Fujikawaguchiko, Oishi, 2585-85 Oishi Park, ２５２５番地の１１先
2848.aj: 〒401-0305 山梨県南都留郡富士河口湖町大石２５８５−８５ 大石公園 ２５２５番地の１１先
2848.ed: Park on Lake Kawaguchiko with Mt. Fuji views, fields of lavender & a kids' playground.
2848.edj: 河口湖にある公園。ラベンダー畑、子供の遊び場がある。富士山を眺望できる。

rv.t: Oishi Park was one of the absolute highlights of our Japan trip. Seeing Mount Fuji from there felt like experiencing it up close for the very first time. We were incredibly fortunate that the mountain was completely visible, as it's often hidden behind clouds for much of the year. Many locals and frequent visitors say you can only expect clear views on around 80–100 days annually, so we definitely felt lucky. The…

On a clear day, this is a fantastic spot to enjoy breathtaking views of Mount Fuji framed by beautiful lavender fields. The combination of the iconic mountain and the colorful flowers makes it a perfect location for photography. The park also has a souvenir shop where you can grab coffee, ice cream, and other local treats while taking a break. If you head up to the upper floor, you'll be rewarded with an even better…

The view from here is magnificent. The Nemophila fields in late May is very nice? There are also a few colourful flowers there still, even in late spring. Not too many people when we came, can get many unobstructed pics of Fujisan and the flower fields. There is a nice souvenir shop nearby but too many people and quite pricey. There is also an ice cream store. It was delicious. Ample parking space, and plenty…

2849.a: petit cafe tronc, 1438-2 Senbacho, Mito, Ibaraki 310-0851, Japan
2849.aj: 〒310-0851 茨城県水戸市千波町１４３８−２ プティカフェ トロン
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店

rv.t: 水戸市にある、お花屋さんとカフェが融合したとても雰囲気の良いお店です。 アンティーク調の家具やたくさんの生花・ドライフラワーに囲まれた店内は、どこを切り取っても素敵で、落ち着いた時間が流れています。 季節の桃のシフォンケーキは、生地がふわふわで果実もとっても新鮮！一緒にいただいたラテも層が綺麗で、目でも舌でも楽しめました。 水戸でゆっくり静かな時間を過ごしたいときには、ここ以上の場所はないかもしれません。店員さんも温かく、また季節を変えて伺いたいと思います。
お花屋さんがやっている喫茶店なので、店内植物がいっぱいです。食事がしたかったので「ラクレットのチーズトースト」をいただきました。香りよく美味しかったです。食事は月替わりで2種類ありました。ブレンドコーヒーも飲みやすいおいしい味です。ミルクを添えてもらったら、温めたミルクをたっぷりつけてくれたので、カフェオレ風にして飲めました。調理はお一人みたいなので、ゆっくり時間がある方向けです。

花屋さんが併設されているので入店した瞬間から店内には緑がたくさんあり素敵な空間でした。 座席はいくつかありましたが、4人席が最大だと思います。 店内は暖房効いてますが、個人的には少し肌寒くかんじました。寒がりな方は、体温調節できる服装で行かれることをおすすめします。 いちごのフレンチトースト、ロイヤルミルクティーをいただきました。 フレンチトーストはクリーム+はちみつがけなのでかなり甘めでしたが美味しかったです☺️(フレンチトーストは提供時間をいただくとのことで、でてくるまでは15分？くらいだったと思います。) フードメニューは、プレートセット、サンドウィッチ、フレンチトーストの3種でした。 ドリンクはホット/アイスともにコーヒーやジュースなど種類は結構あったと思います。 ・平日のお昼頃 ・駐車場あり ・クレジット不可、現金のみ

2850.a: Japan, 〒135-0006 Tokyo, Koto City, Tokiwa, 1 Chome−4−7 iki Roastery & Eatery
2850.aj: 〒135-0006 東京都江東区常盤１丁目４−７ iki Roastery & Eatery
2850.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, a wide variety of pastries, and hearty brunch plates, with many highlighting the flavorful croissants and carrot cake. They also appreciate the spacious, stylish atmosphere and the friendly, efficient staff. Some reviews mention the food can be overpriced.
2850.edj: クチコミによると、このカフェは美味しいコーヒー、豊富な種類のパンやケーキ、ボリュームのあるブランチプレートを提供しており、特に風味豊かなクロワッサンやキャロットケーキが高く評価されています。また、広々としておしゃれな雰囲気や、親しみやすく効率的なスタッフの対応も好評です。 一方で、料理の値段が割高だと感じるという意見もあります。

rv.t: Super stylish cafe with immaculate ambience. We went there as soon as it opened and had breakfast and coffee. I’m pretty sure they grind their own coffee in house. Their interior as well as exterior are super well designed, so everything blends into a beautiful cafe. Although I probably won’t be going back, it’s still a cool dining experience. 10/10 felt cool eating there

iki Roastery & Eatery is a superb coffee experience. You could feel the love and pride they have on their coffee, with the way the coffee tastes and how they treat their products. Their pastries is highly recommended. I could say that the place is worth the hype. If visiting on a weekend, be prepared to queue for about an hour or less because it's very popular.

I came for the breakfast, matcha latte and pain suisse. Love it ! The pastries are delicious. The place and vibe are very good. In front for the Sumida river. A lot of space. Great for groups. Dogs welcome ! 🐶

2851.a: キッチン・カフェ クランボン, 2428-5 Matsuyama, Higashimatsuyama, Saitama 355-0005, Japan
2851.aj: 〒355-0005 埼玉県東松山市松山２４２８−５ キッチン カフェ クランボン
2851.ed: Diners appreciate this cafe for its charming, Ghibli-esque atmosphere and a menu featuring tasty gratin, flavorful pasta, and hearty pork steak. They also highlight the reasonable prices offered. Some reviews mention the food can be ordinary.
2851.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、魅力的なジブリのような雰囲気と、美味しいグラタン、風味豊かなパスタ、ボリュームのあるポークステーキが楽しめるメニューが高く評価されています。また、手頃な価格も特徴として挙げられています。 一方で、料理がごく普通だと感じるという意見もあります。

rv.t: Very impressive building inside and out. It reminds me of the Critter County area of Disney! They refer to it as an old barnhouse and it has that feel on the inside. There is a main floor and two upper levels, one of which is just a mezzanine. The very top floor can be used for private functions and it has two small balconies. The restaurant is a little pricey, but it's worth it for the quirkiness of the building…
Food was okay. Staffs are very nice. The location and the building are the cutest thing ever. This place is a must visit.
Rural atmosphere can be fwlt here with high quality pizza and omrette.

rv.t: This is one of less than 5 places open for dinner (past 5-6pm) in Amanohashidate! Having done my research beforehand I knew we had to book at least a day in advance. We walked up on the second night and book for our third night. The lovely lady took our booking and it's 100% just based on trust that you are coming so please please ensure you go if you book. We showed up the next night and our first course of a…

This was one of the best meals I have ever eaten. We visited on 7/7/26 and had the place to ourselves. We arrived to the table set with the most amazing plates of starters - mainly vegetables but all absolute standouts. This was followed by a delicious pork salad with a truly delicious dressing. After that was a tempura plate with chicken and vegetable tempura with some of the lightest batter I’ve ever had…
An incredible omakase obanzai meal where the wonderful chef and her team served locally sourced food prepared into amazing traditional homemade dishes. Highly recommended.

2853.ed: Diners like this restaurant's fresh seafood dishes, including delicious sashimi, grilled fish, and comforting udon bowls like the clam udon. They also highlight the reasonable prices for the quality and the welcoming atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are friendly and attentive, and appreciate the stairlift for accessibility.
2853.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、新鮮な魚介類を高く評価しています。特に、海鮮丼、焼き魚、カニうどんが人気で、ボリュームがあり心温まる料理だというクチコミが多くあります。価格が手頃で、居心地の良い雰囲気も好評です。親切で気配りの行き届いたスタッフの対応も評価されており、2階の食事スペースへは階段昇降機が設置されているため、利用しやすいという声もあります。

rv.t: ⭐ Positive Review for Showabussan Restaurant 松和物産 本店 ⭐ We had a wonderful meal at Showabussan Restaurant 松和物産 本店. The food was delicious and comforting, and the atmosphere felt warm and authentic. Most of the staff were incredibly friendly, kind, and helpful. Only the staff member taking the order seemed a little sleepy, but everyone else made the experience very pleasant with their attentiveness and polite service…

The first time we know of eating the look-like raw Buri fish in hot pot. We absolutely love raw fish but dipping them in hot pot then eating it is also delicious. It seems to be the tradition in the area to do fish hot pot. We also saw the same buri raw fish sold in some Kyoto supermarket.

I stumbled upon Showabussan Restaurant during a free-and-easy tour on a public holiday in early January. It was fairly crowded but did not require a long wait to be seated. Located on the second floor, the restaurant offers a variety of seafood dishes especially crab. I ordered their sashimi set, which tasted incredibly fresh! Priced at around 1,800 Yen, I found the quality excellent, and the accompanying side…

rv.t: The BEST noodle restaurant in 天橋立！ The place is clean and the staff are very nice. Both the cold soba and udon are tasty. Free cold/hot water or tea are provided too. Highly recommended!
Unexpectedly amazing restaurant. We stopped by for a quick bite and got recharged before continuing our trip, but everything we ordered is so delicious.

A must try if you are mochi and red bean lover! One box of three are around 300 yen. There are other bigger size if you want to buy as souvenirs. The mochi is very soft and smell of rice. Anko was very fine with just-right sweetness.

2855.a: Ryugu Soba, 472-1 Monju, Miyazu, Kyoto 626-0001, Japan
2855.aj: 〒626-0001 京都府宮津市文珠４７２−１ 龍宮そば
2855.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious soba and udon, especially the crispy tempura, and appreciate the generous portions, reasonable prices, and fast service. Other reviews mention the soba can be dry and sticky, and service can be inattentive.
2855.edj: このお店を利用した人は、そばやうどん、特にサクサクの天ぷらを美味しいと評価しています。また、ボリュームがあること、値段が手頃なこと、そして料理の提供が早いことにも満足しているようです。 一方で、そばが乾いていて粘り気があるという意見や、店員の対応が丁寧ではないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: On our daytrip, we asked our van driver to bring us to lunch at a restaurant in Amanohashidate. He recommended Ryugu Soba, a restaurant that serves fragrant buckwheat noodles from Ine. The meal was a set menu of either udon or soba. Most of us had the shrimp tempura set. The service was fast and the food was very good.
I had the hot soba noodles and it was good and the hot soup was a welcome feel to the cold weather! Tempura was good too! The place is quite spacious.
Loved the soba, got the shrimp tempura portion and it did not disappoint! The tempura was fried so well, thin light crispy batter with a variety of vegetables alongside two big pieces of shrimp.

rv.t: Awesome experience. If you're quick you can make 3-4 small pieces. The staff is very friendly and helpful and really guide you without interrupting your creativity. I loved my experience so much I went twice in one week. I know people come for the pottery but I want to mention that the food served for lunch is also so tasty.

Had a wonderful dinner experience here at Tototo! The evening started with a warm welcome from the staff members, as I was guided to my seat at a bar-style counter. I experienced a full course meal that incorporates vegetables, poultry, and fish of the season. Blown away. Their sake selection was also impeccable, with a wide selection of bottles they provide for a very reasonable price and even give you descriptions…
This is a fantastic restaurant. I really enjoyed creating potteries and foods(also Japanese sake). It is a good point that we can book on online. I’m looking forward to receive my potteries.

2858.ed: People say this souvenir shop offers delicious crab bentos and saba sushi, featuring fresh, local ingredients and unique packaging. They also highlight the generous portions of crab and the flavorful rice. Visitors mention the staff provides good service, and the bentos are worth the wait despite the limited quantities.
2858.edj: クチコミによると、このお土産店では、新鮮な地元食材を使った美味しいカニ弁当とサバ寿司が評判です。ユニークなパッケージも特徴で、カニの身がたっぷり入っている点や、風味豊かなご飯も高く評価されています。スタッフのサービスも良いという声があり、数量限定のため待つこともありますが、それだけの価値がある弁当だと利用した人は感じているようです。

rv.t: I saw that this was sold out at 2pm on the day we arrived, so we came back two days later around 12pm and managed to snagged the crab bentos! The yakisaba ones were already sold out. The crab is fresh and the rice is incredibly yummy, both hot and cold options are good, but I love the kanisushi option a lot more! The vinegared rice went well with the fresh crab. Get a bento and sit by the coast or river for maximum…

Local souvenir shop that sell bento. Open 11.00AM -local ingredients such as pickle vegetable, processed seafood -3 menu of bento (2 crab, 1 saba fish) -the packaging of bento is interesting -the taste of bento is natural sweet from crab, saba sushi is good -the shop is near the train station -the shop have no seat for eating

A truly delightful culinary discovery in the quiet seaside town of Funaya. The kanimeshi (crab rice) was beautifully presented in a bamboo sheath, capturing both the simplicity and elegance of traditional Japanese craftsmanship. The rice was delicately seasoned and infused with the sweetness of fresh crab, creating a gentle balance of umami and natural flavor. Every detail from the aroma of the bamboo to the…

2859.ed: Set meals, a modest menu & sea views in a bustling seafood restaurant above a fishmonger's.
2859.edj: 魚屋の上階にある人気の海鮮料理店。海の景色を見ながら定食や単品を味わえる。

rv.t: Fresh from the sea! There is a parking nearby the building. The restaurant is on the 2nd floor. Auntie doesn't speak English, but she's so nice and welcome. There are photos on the wall that you can use for a reference when ordering. The windows seat table is highly recommended 🥰
I really like for everything including the taste 😋, price is reasonable, fresh materials and the service is nice. I come here 11.40 AM weekday and no queue. I would love to come back again.

The seafood is fresh and very generous in their cut. We were lucky to just wait for an even though we came at about 1pm. We were given the ‘prime seats’ of facing the sea! Good food and good view. Staff is friendly too.

2860.ed: People say this restaurant offers fresh, delicious seafood, including sashimi and oysters, and a wide variety of affordable dishes like tempura and ramen. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the lively, retro atmosphere. Other reviews mention the service can be impolite.
2860.edj: クチコミでは、このお店は新鮮で美味しい刺身や牡蠣などの魚介類、そして天ぷらやラーメンといった手頃な価格の料理を幅広く提供していると評判です。また、リーズナブルな価格設定と活気のあるレトロな雰囲気が特徴として挙げられています。 一方で、サービスが丁寧でないという意見もあります。

rv.t: After reading the reviews, I was prepared for the worst. In fact, the staff greeted us warmly and even helped a little. Those to whom waitresses were rude probably taking up too much of the staff's time in a very busy establishment. I have no other explanation. The food was excellent – the sets were delicious, lots of fresh fish, a large udon for only 300, and large, juicy oysters for 550. I was glad I stopped in –…

🦪 Asari Clam Steamed 1,600¥ 🍣 Sashimi Set Meal 1,200¥ 🐟🍲 Boiled Fish Bone Set Meal 600¥ 🍤🍜 Tempura Udon 810¥ 📍富田屋, Miyazu, Kyoto If you’re in Miyazu visiting Amanohashidate, this local seafood restaurant is absolutely worth it 🌊✨ It’s a small, traditional shop with a very authentic Japanese seaside atmosphere — simple, no-frills, and focused on fresh ingredients from the nearby coast. Overall, the seafood here…

Environment is pretty much in a old school setting. Food served, nothing to shout about. Menu with english translation can get quite amusing, probably part of the 'fun', isn't it? Then the real challenge came when attending staff gets impatient and starts to get rude. Maybe they are use to serving their regulars/ locals and when a foreigner steps in, everyone panick (including us) due to language barrier. But, why…

They also highlight the knowledgeable and friendly staff who provide clear, detailed instructions, often with English interpretation available. Guests mention the calm, clean atmosphere and the opportunity to sample various…
2861.edj: この発酵ワークショップを利用した人は、梅酒や塩麹、醤油麹作りなど、様々な体験ができる点を評価しています。材料や味をカスタマイズできる選択肢があることも好評です。また、知識が豊富で親しみやすいスタッフが、分かりやすく丁寧な説明をしてくれるという声が多く、英語での説明も可能というクチコミもあります。店内は落ち着いた清潔な雰囲気で、様々な発酵食品や飲み物を試飲できる機会も好評のようです。

rv.t: I had Flavored salt Koji making experience workshop. It’s such a good experience. The Sensei and staffs are nice. You can requested for a translator if you need.

Make your own umeshu! Such a unique experience. The staff is so friendly and helpful. You get to choose your sweetener, base alcohol, and flavor. The instructor was very helpful. A souvenir you get to savor later. An experience I won’t soon forget!
Great experience! My first time making plum wine at Kyoto. I really enjoy it. I recommend everyone to come and try!

2862.a: Starbucks Reserve® Roastery Tokyo, 2 Chome-19-23 Aobadai, Meguro City, Tokyo 153-0042, Japan

2862.ed: Welcoming coffeehouse with handcrafted coffee, espresso & tea, plus breakfast, lunch & pastries.
2862.edj: クチコミによると、このコーヒーショップは、ユニークなコーヒー、紅茶、カクテルが豊富に揃っており、Princiベーカリーの美味しいパンやフードも楽しめることで評判です。また、複数階にわたる素晴らしい建築デザインや、コーヒー豆の焙煎工程を見学できる魅力的な雰囲気も高く評価されています。スタッフは親切で丁寧、サービスも素晴らしく、忘れられない体験ができるという声が多く聞かれます。

rv.t: My visit to Starbucks Reserve Tokyo was one of the highlights of my trip to Japan. The building itself is stunning, with a unique design, spacious interior, and a warm atmosphere that makes you want to stay for hours. Every floor offers a different experience, and I enjoyed walking around, taking photos, and recording videos of the beautiful architecture and coffee-making process. During my visit, I ordered the…

A must do! Easy access via Yamanote line > Shibuya > exit Hachiko exit and walk to the 41 or 42 bus (suica card OK) then four stops to Sugekari Elem Sch > once off the bus make a left at the light and you will be there! Easy! Helpful staff and the 3 floors have different offerings. Great store - a must if you are a Starbucks fan. We had the ham croissants, a martini espresso flight and a tea citrus- all very tasty…

I knew by heart that all Starbucks Japan stores are great, but this was otherworldly greatness. Since it was off-peak season, we didn’t have to wait at all and just got seated immediately. There were lots of available seats and we’d love an outdoor table too, but the summer heat kept us inside. The menu was unlike any Starbucks Reserve Roastery’s menus I’ve ever seen before - I swear, I just kept going. There were…

2863.a: Japan, 〒104-0061 Tokyo, Chuo City, Ginza, 5 Chome−2−1 東急プラザ銀座 The Mint Ginza | Rooftop Cafe & Bar 11階/ルーフトップ
2863.aj: 〒104-0061 東京都中央区銀座５丁目２−１ 東急プラザ銀座 The Mint Ginza | Rooftop Cafe & Bar 11階/ルーフトップ
2863.ed: People say this rooftop bar offers stunning city views, a lively yet relaxed atmosphere with good music, and a wide variety of drinks and light meals, including delicious tacos and juicy frankfurters. Other reviews mention the service can be indifferent and the atmosphere can be poorly maintained.
2863.edj: クチコミによると、この屋上バーは素晴らしい街の景色、活気がありながらも落ち着いた雰囲気、そして美味しいタコスやジューシーなフランクフルトを含む豊富な種類のドリンクや軽食を提供していると評判です。 一方で、スタッフの対応があまり良くない、店内の雰囲気が十分に手入れされていないという意見もあります。

rv.t: I visited weekday early evening. There were couple other groups but felt somewhat deserted. The staff were welcoming and I had their high ball (900 yen). It tasted pretty strong. The view from the rooftop was pretty. It was cold that evening but they had some heaters outside. They played (I think) American radio with hip hop music so oddly it felt like I was back in the U.S. While it seemed fitting it wasn't exactly…
Great atmosphere with beautiful Tokyo city view. Delicious cocktails. Attentive staff with friendly service.

Rooftop with view is cool… but while you ordering cocktails in your table can be fallen…. In evening here is just small food for drinks… no main food like in photos and reception which we asked she said food here … where ? :) No didn’t take away your drinks from table if people left it… strange

2864.a: Narashino City Plum Grove Garden, 4 Chome-4 Saginumadai, Narashino, Chiba 275-0015, Japan
2864.aj: 〒275-0015 千葉県習志野市鷺沼台４丁目４ 習志野市梅林園

rv.t: 2026.2.23午前中に来訪。イヌの散歩の方がチラホラ見受けられましたが、空いていました。 こじんまりとした公園で10分あれば見られます。梅は7,8分咲きで見頃でした。 数年前？から道路の拡張工事を公園の脇でやっている関係で、一部梅の木を植え替えたりしているようです。そのためなのでしょうか、梅の剪定が他の梅園と異なっていました。梅の花を歩きながら風流に見学する風(梅の花を間近で見たり、枝ぶりを見惚れて歩く感じ)には剪定されておらず、空に向かって枝が一律に伸びていて梅の花が少し遠いです。素人なのでこれが下手なのか、或いはこういう剪定の仕方もあるのか、将来に向けての準備なのかは定かではありません。 トイレは常設のものではなく、建築現場にありそうな一人用のものがあります。 今のところは近所にあって気軽に行けるのなら行こうかな、という評価になります。道路工事や移設作業の終わる近い将来に期待したいです。
綺麗な梅園、とてもメンテナンスがされていて、良い公園です。 連休中日、梅を観る人達で溢れていました。 とっても綺麗な梅たちに、心が癒されました。 メンテナンス、引き続き頑張って下さい。
250309 満開は先週？ 散り始めてましたが綺麗でした。 有るのは知ってたけど梅の時期は初めてでした。 住宅街の一画にあり、駐車場が見当たりませんでした。 路駐はかなり迷惑だと思います。 私は自転車だったので問題なし。 近所の方？が沢山散歩してました。 次は満開狙うぞ！

2865.a: Aguri Park Sagayamaen, 2853 Matsudasoryo, Matsuda, Ashigarakami District, Kanagawa 258-0004, Japan
2865.aj: 〒258-0004 神奈川県足柄上郡松田町松田惣領２８５３ あぐりパーク嵯峨山苑
2865.ed: Visitors say this park offers stunning panoramic views of the ocean, Mount Fuji, and vibrant seasonal flowers like cherry blossoms and canola flowers. They also highlight the peaceful atmosphere, making it a great spot to enjoy nature. Guests mention the 500 yen admission fee and the option to pick canola flowers for an additional charge.
2865.edj: この公園を訪れた人は、海や富士山、桜や菜の花といった季節ごとの美しい花々が織りなす素晴らしいパノラマの景色を高く評価しています。また、静かで穏やかな雰囲気も特徴で、自然を満喫するのに最適な場所という声もあります。入園料は500円で、追加料金を払うと菜の花摘みも楽しめるという情報があります。

rv.t: If you're dreaming of that classic Japanese spring scene – delicate pink sakura dancing alongside vibrant yellow canola fields – then this spot delivers in spades! Seriously, the contrast is breathtaking and makes for some truly stunning photos. Imagine layers of soft pink against a sea of bright yellow, all under a clear sky... yeah, it's that good. Just a heads-up though, those incredible panoramic views come with…

I was planning to go to the Matsuda Cherry Blossom Festival. I was thinking of taking a bus, but changed my mind when I saw the long line in front of the station. I walked to the festival site. I just followed the flow of people. Everyone was walking towards the mountain, so I wondered where the festival was. I walked for about 20 minutes, then realized I'd passed the festival site. But I arrived at Agri Park…

The hike to this park is definitely not easy, but the views do make it worth it. Especially since it is a great place to get away from the crowds down below. Many people were taking professional photos and with the gorgeous blossoms, this is a great place to do that. Entrance fee is 300 yen. Just follow the signs from the lower blossoms up to the top.

2866.a: Nishihirabatake Park, 2951 Matsudasoryo, Matsuda, Ashigarakami District, Kanagawa 258-0003, Japan
2866.aj: 〒258-0003 神奈川県足柄上郡松田町松田惣領２９５１ 西平畑公園
2866.ed: Hilltop park with a tiny shrine & miniature railway, plus herb gardens & spring cherry blossoms.
2866.edj: 小さな神社やミニ鉄道がある山の上の公園。ハーブガーデンや、春には桜も楽しめる。

rv.t: I visited this park on 13th February during the festivals. The sakura has already bloom. It was so beautiful. The view of Matsuda with cherry blossom is very pretty

Went February 17, 2026. Flowers were beautifully blooming and was very visible from afar the moment you enter the region. We parked near the river and took a shuttle up, paid admission, and explored. Its a small park but is heavily laden with blossoming trees and has a gorgeous view of the area. Highly recommend going!
Great park absolutely worth it! Check the Plum Grove, too, because it's close. You can do both in one day if you arrive early! Pictures taken on February 22nd.

2867.a: Japan, 〒258-0003 Kanagawa, Ashigarakami District, Matsuda, Matsudasoryo, 1315-16 とんかつ零 松田店
2867.aj: 〒258-0003 神奈川県足柄上郡松田町松田惣領１３１５−１６ とんかつ零 松田店
2867.ed: Diners like this restaurant's thick-cut, juicy, and tender tonkatsu, with many highlighting the "Tokujo" (special prime) option for its superior quality. They also appreciate the variety of seasonings available, such as wasabi and sansho salt, which enhance the flavor. Guests mention the generous portion sizes and the friendly, attentive staff.
2867.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーは、厚切りでジューシー、そして柔らかいとんかつを高く評価しています。特に「特上」は、その優れた品質が多くの人から絶賛されています。また、わさびや山椒塩など、味のバリエーションを楽しめる豊富な調味料も好評です。ボリューム満点な点や、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフの対応も良いクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: We are alone here after the cherry blossom festival . And from the start I was BLOWN AWAY by the amazing quality and taste of this pork… I ended up ordering 300g TWICE ! I’ve tasted 12 katsu places in Tokyo and this by far is my fav above those . Must hav after a long day

Had an excellent bowl of katsudon. The sauce has already been applied to the pork cutlet. Thickness of the pork cutlet is just nice. The egg is cooked to perfection. Chef applied a layer of sauce at the bottom of the rice which make the whole Don taste heavenly. Flavor and texture is at its optimal.
The best Katsudon I've had. The meat is tender and juicy and the egg and rice are perfect as well The staff was able to explain the menu in English so we could order Great experience overall

2867.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2868.a: Odawara Castle Ninja Centre, 2-6 Jonai, Odawara, Kanagawa 250-0014, Japan
2868.aj: 〒250-0014 神奈川県小田原市城内２−６ 小田原城NINJA館
2868.ed: People say this ninja museum offers interactive ninja experiences and obstacle courses, including digital shuriken throwing, which children particularly enjoy. They also highlight the reasonable entry fee and the friendly, helpful staff. Some reviews mention the facility can be small.
2868.edj: この忍者博物館を利用した人は、デジタル手裏剣投げを含む、体験型の忍者体験や障害物コースを楽しめると評価しています。特に子供が楽しんでいるようです。また、手頃な入場料と、親切で気の利くスタッフも高く評価されています。 クチコミの中には、施設が狭いという意見もあります。

rv.t: For a cheap entry fee of ¥310, you really get an experience. It's not just a museum, but also an obstacle course that actually gets you exercising: rope climbing, wall hugging, memory games, and even a shuriken-throwing boss fight. I'd say it's more targeted towards kids, judging by how physically small a lot of the minigames were, but adults can also benefit from the body coordination practice, even if it's just…
It is a good place to hang out with the kids, only short games around. Just cost 500¥ per person, and the games is good.
Not just a museum, but we could have experiance as a ninja

2869.a: Minamiboso Ninja Village, 400 Ebishiki, Minamiboso, Chiba 294-0804, Japan
2869.aj: 〒294-0804 千葉県南房総市海老敷４００ 南房総 忍者の里

rv.t: They were pricey for a cash-only amusement. Might not be a good place for families with kids under 7 years old

This is a place to be a ninja. There's all sorts of things to do outside in the great outdoors, including exploring a ninja hut and swinging on a trapeze. My favorites parts were putting on ninja clothes, throwing ninja stars, climbing trees, and walking on a tightrope. I felt like a real ninja!
Actual real ninja house with nature obstacle course for a taste of “ninja training”. Great for ages 5 and up! Brings out the “Naruto” in you!

2870.a: Akebi Onsen, 原-19-26 Kosagoe, Nikko, Tochigi 321-2525, Japan
2870.aj: 〒321-2525 栃木県日光市小佐越原19−２６ 離れの湯 あけび
2870.ed: People say this onsen offers private, open-air baths with great views of nature, and guests appreciate the option to rent a whole cabin for a secluded experience. They also highlight the friendly staff and the convenience of bringing your own food and drinks. Some reviews mention the baths can be poorly maintained.
2870.edj: クチコミによると、この温泉は自然の素晴らしい景色を望む貸し切りの露天風呂が特徴です。また、一棟貸しの客室で人目を気にせず過ごせる点も利用した人に好評です。親しみやすいスタッフの対応や、飲食物を持ち込める利便性も高く評価されています。 一方で、浴槽の清掃が行き届いていないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Absolutely amazing outdoor onsen in Nikko. Such a hidden gem it was like a fairytale cabin in the woods and each unit is private with two bathtubs on two levels overlooking the river and nature so it’s picture perfect beautiful and private. The staff are so friendly and gave us omiyage when we arrived! The twinkle lights at night with the nature was amazing. I can’t wait to go back again!!

We called on 10 Dec 25 to book a 3hr private family onsen for 11th. It is a wonderful serene experience. We only used the top onsen as it was much hotter than the open aired one but the top one was good as it was on a covered balcony but still open to view the river. As we booked from 1500hrs onwards, to see the place turned to night is magical esp after our bath as the whole forest was litted in small walk way…

The place was as beautiful as advertised. It was a bit far from the nearest bus stop (10-15 mins walking), but the views were nice. We only had bit of problem bringing luggage down to the front desk (stone path). The room was nice, clean and had a lot of trees covering the outdoor baths. There weren't vending machines for drinks, so either bring your own or buy from the front desk. Would definitely recommend…

2871.a: Makaino Farm Resort, 1327-1 Utsuno, Fujinomiya, Shizuoka 418-0104, Japan
2871.aj: 〒418-0104 静岡県富士宮市内野１３２７−１ まかいの牧場
2871.ed: Interactive farm with livestock, activities, play equipment, views of Mount Fuji & a restaurant.
2871.edj: 動物とのふれあい、アクティビティ、遊具、富士山の眺めが楽しめる体験型の牧場。レストランもある。

rv.t: Best view of Mt Fuji on the swing, feed the sheep, walk a goat, awesome authentic food using farm fresh ingredients. When Fuji is blocked this is still a great spot to spend time while you are chasing Fuji-San. Don’t miss out on the Fuji icecream made with fresh milk. There’s plenty of small eats and restaurants on the premise you’ll have options don’t look outside and just take your time you will spend a good 1-2hr…

Lots of animals to see but can be hard work walking around lots of slopes. Unfortunately weather wasn’t great unable to see Mount Fuji properly, otherwise it would be a great photo spot. Several simple snack and icecream and drink store inside and main restaurant before entrance. There is also some workshops and activities able to participate.

Our driver took us to the farm, we didn't know what to expect. It was a pleasant surprise as it was a very good location, the weather was very kind to us, not too hot not too cold. We spend over two hours to walk up the hill and took many beautiful photos with Mt Fuji and surrounding farm locations. It very nice for a family picnic too. Highly recommend it!

2872.a: Café Shizen, 498 Nebara, Fujinomiya, Shizuoka 418-0101, Japan
2872.aj: 〒418-0101 静岡県富士宮市根原４９８ Cafe Shizen
2872.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious food, including hearty gratin and egg sandwiches, alongside a variety of excellent wines for tasting and purchase. They also highlight the stunning views of Mount Fuji from the stylish interior and the warm, natural ambiance. Guests mention the staff are friendly and attentive, and appreciate the dog-friendly indoor seating.
2872.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、心温まるグラタンや卵サンドイッチなどの料理が美味しいと評判です。また、様々な種類の素晴らしいワインを試飲したり購入したりできる点も高く評価されています。おしゃれな店内から富士山の素晴らしい景色を眺めることができ、温かく自然な雰囲気が特徴です。スタッフは親しみやすく、きめ細やかな対応をしてくれるという声が多く、犬を連れて店内に入れることも喜ばれています。

rv.t: A variety of great tasting wine, friendly staff and owners, winery tours, Stunning views of Mt Fuji when it wants to show itself, desserts and dishes signature to Japan. It’s worth the drive or the jelly flight from Tokyo! :) IG: @tokyomuncher

There is a fabulous ad on social media that advertises a special day at Fujisan Winery/Cafe Shizen. While sometimes I’m skeptical of ads that appear “too good to be true,” Cafe Shizen was as amazing as professed! So this review is of the advertised package which I highly recommend! Indeed, you are picked up at Shin-Fuji station by a guide holding a clear sign. We then took the comfortable 1+ hour drive to the…

Small amazing cafe/restaurant in the middle of the mountain! Owner gave us abit of introduction to the family business! Serves amazing food, creative drinks and the freshly baked bread rolls are TO DIE FOR! Hands down the best bread rolls I had in my life! It was moist and dense but yet light at the same time! Paired so well with everything! Definitely will return if I had the chance! Just over anything and…

2872.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2873.a: Japan, 〒401-0501 Yamanashi, Minamitsuru District, Yamanakako, Yamanaka, 285-83 暮らしの香り 山中湖アトリエ
2873.aj: 〒401-0501 山梨県南都留郡山中湖村山中２８５−８３ 暮らしの香り 山中湖アトリエ
2873.ed: Visitors say this cafe offers a wide variety of aromatic products and a pleasant space to enjoy drinks. They also highlight the tranquil atmosphere, allowing for a relaxing experience away from crowded areas. Others mention the staff are helpful and provide thoughtful advice.
2873.edj: このカフェを訪れた人は、種類豊富なアロマ製品と、飲み物を楽しめる心地よい空間を評価しています。また、混雑した場所から離れてリラックスできる、穏やかな雰囲気が特徴のようです。スタッフは親切で、きめ細やかなアドバイスをしてくれるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: 山中湖町役場奥の場所にある、おしゃれなカフェ。香りグッズを販売する会社が運営。静かな場所でゆっくりと美しい富士を眺めることができます。山中湖湖畔のカフェは混んでいることが多いので個人的にはこちらが好きです。
名前通りアトリエでした！ 店舗自体はコンパクトでしたが、さまざまな香りがあって悩みました〜。 店員さんが優しくアドバイスをしてくれて、 凄く良かったです♪ 犬は店内には入れ無いのですが、庭が整備されており、愛犬連れでも気持ち良く遊べます！

山中湖湖畔から少し入った場所にあるアトリエ。別荘地に突如として現れる広大な空間。 真正面に富士山が聳え立ち抜群のロケーション。庭も建屋も非常にお洒落。癒やしの空間として山中湖に来たら是非寄りたい場所。 店内は天然の香り製品がところ狭しと並べられておりクオリティが高い。製品は一つ一つ丁寧に説明していただける。 併設のカフェはスツールが3脚のみと狭いが窓が額縁のごとく絶景の富士山が眺められる。 屋外にもテーブルと椅子があるので天気の良い日には絶景の富士山を眺めながら過ごせて非常に気持ちいい。

2873.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2874.a: Chaseki, 1300-307 Gora, Hakone, Ashigarashimo District, Kanagawa 250-0408, Japan
2874.aj: 〒250-0408 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町強羅１３００−３０７ 茶石
2874.ed: People say this tea house offers a unique tea experience with high-quality, rare tea varieties, often brewed three times to enjoy changing flavors. They also highlight the beautiful, modern interior and calm atmosphere, which creates a relaxing environment. Guests mention the staff are attentive and provide excellent service, and many appreciate the unique experience of eating the tea leaves with…
2874.edj: この茶屋を訪れた人は、高品質で珍しいお茶を体験できると評価しています。多くのお茶は3煎に分けて淹れられ、味の変化を楽しめる点が特徴です。また、モダンで美しい内装と落ち着いた雰囲気も高く評価されており、リラックスできる空間だと好評です。スタッフは気配りができており、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているという声が多くあります。さらに、茶葉をポン酢で食べるという珍しい体験も好評です。

rv.t: Zen tea house with a modern interior. They have rotating specials, and I tried a Gyokuro that blew my mind. There is a recommended number of times that the tea can be brewed. The first and second cups were full of umami flavors, and the third brew was mellow and clean. It was a highly enjoyable experience!

We decided to go here on a whim to warm ourselves from the cold and it was a truly zen and insightful experience on tea preparation! We ordered two different types of matcha and it had very different flavour profiles. They did 3 extractions so you get to taste the tea differently every time. Loved the elaborate preparation process. There were also wagashi and mochi to complement the tea. The atmosphere was so calm…

Was interested in visiting this place since planning for the trip. It didn't disappoint. Atmosphere is good, quiet and the sound of the staff working on crafting the tea and serving the Wagashi adds to the mood. Selection of sweets are nice and we were lucky to have another customer helping us with communicating with the staff. They do have English menu and it's easy to order. Wagashi is nice and in season, doesn't…

2874.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:30

2875.a: Coffee Shop Yoshino, 1379 Yamanouchi, Kamakura, Kanagawa 247-0062, Japan
2875.aj: 〒247-0062 神奈川県鎌倉市山ノ内１３７９ 喫茶吉野
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2875.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious coffee, especially the siphon-brewed blend, and its moist fruit and pound cakes. They also highlight the calm, retro atmosphere, which is perfect for relaxing. Guests mention the staff are kind and attentive, and that payment is cash only.
2875.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、サイフォンで淹れたブレンドコーヒーをはじめとする美味しいコーヒーや、しっとりとしたフルーツケーキ、パウンドケーキを高く評価しています。また、落ち着いたレトロな雰囲気はリラックスするのに最適という声が多くあります。スタッフは親切で気配りが素晴らしいというクチコミもありますが、支払いは現金のみという情報もあります。

rv.t: We ordered two hand-made fruit cakes, two black coffee and a mini-cookies portion. It was a delicious breakfast to start the day in the right way😍. The three women who served us were really kind! Coffee is a special one, must try it! Arigatō & Grazie mille🇮🇹🇯🇵🙏🏼

Americans on vacation. Stumbled upon this coffee shop while visiting temples. Never would have known this was here, but glad we discovered it. Pound cake, cookies, coffee, Lemon “squash” which we took to be fresh squeezed lemonade and orange juice were all amazing. It was a great place to take a load off our feet and plan the next thing we were going to do. We were welcomed, literally with open arms, while we were…
Serene old style cafe with calming atmosphere, excellent coffee and delicious cakes

2875.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2876.a: RoheN HAKONEYUMOTO, 647 Yumoto, Hakone, Ashigarashimo District, Kanagawa 250-0311, Japan
2876.aj: 〒250-0311 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町湯本６４７ RoheN Hakone Yumoto
2876.ed: People say this hotel offers private onsens, a cozy lounge, and delicious breakfast options, including a notable caramel banana smoothie. They also highlight the convenient location, being a short walk from the train station, and the helpful staff. Guests mention the reasonable prices and the beautiful, stylish interior.
2876.edj: このホテルを利用した人は、貸し切りの温泉や居心地の良いラウンジ、そしてキャラメルバナナスムージーが特に美味しい朝食を高く評価しています。また、駅から歩いてすぐという便利な立地や、親切なスタッフも好評のようです。手頃な価格で、美しくおしゃれな内装も宿泊客に喜ばれています。

rv.t: Very nice looking hotel and a ~10 minutes walk from the station. The interior is cosy with a candle lit atmosphere. The second floor has a large sitting area where you can heat up your own food. The hotel also has 2 designated smoking areas, one of them being a very cosy terrace on the second floor. Breakfast was included and it was ok but nothing special. Dinner was very good but a bit expensive for what it was…

This was such an excellent find! If we ever come back I wouldnt hesitate to book again. Beautifully laid out and stylish, in a quiet corner of the village. The large windows in the lounge/ lobby let in lots of natural light and views of outside greenery makes the space feel very relaxed, perfect place to unwind after a day exploring Hakone loop. Open mezzanine ceiling, comfy lounges, hospitable guest dining space…

Cozy and stylish. We stayed for one night as a group of four in two rooms. The place is lovely, well cared for, pleasant and beautifully designed. We felt comfortable and even had dinner there: very simple, but cozy. The welcome cocktail was excellent and the instructions we received were very helpful. Breakfast was great! Unfortunately, the room walls are very thin, and there is no elevator.

2877.a: Oi Racecourse, 2 Chome-1-2 Katsushima, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 140-0012, Japan
2877.aj: 〒140-0012 東京都品川区勝島２丁目１−２ 大井競馬場
catj: 子供のアミューズメント センター
2877.ed: Visitors say this racecourse offers stunning winter illuminations and a wide variety of delicious food options, including udon, katsu curry, and yakisoba. They also highlight the clean facilities, including restrooms, and the convenient access via monorail or shuttle bus. Guests mention the reasonable admission fee and the friendly, helpful staff, making it an enjoyable experience for families…
2877.edj: クチコミによると、この競馬場は冬のイルミネーションが素晴らしく、うどん、カツカレー、焼きそばなど、多種多様な美味しい食事が楽しめると評判です。また、トイレを含む施設が清潔であることや、モノレールやシャトルバスでのアクセスが便利な点も評価されています。手頃な入場料と親切で気の利くスタッフのおかげで、家族やカップルにとって楽しい場所だという声が多くあります。

rv.t: It was a huge place!!! Inside the illumination was so cool. We went for the illuminqtion and there was a show every 15 minutes. A lot of places and food trucks as well. Such a nice experience for adults and kids alike. There were a lot of locals and it surprised me there were very few foreigners. Its really close to shibuya, shinjuku area so its surprising to me. Hehe

I visited Oi Racecourse for the Christmas illumination event, and it was absolutely stunning! ✨ The light displays were magical, with vibrant colors and intricate designs creating a truly festive atmosphere. The organizers did a fantastic job of setting up interactive light installations, making it a great spot for photos and family fun. The venue was spacious and well-organized, so even with the crowd, it felt…

This is the best holiday lights ever! Tokyo Racecourse showed the greatest illumination! The illumination realizes the beautiful Japanese four seasons.
